evidence.statement: eastserve.com 由电子政务部长 Ian McCartney 于 2001-03-13 正式发布。
evidence.quote_or_span: will be officially launched by Electronic Government Minister Ian McCartney on March 13

evidence.statement: 项目由 New Deal for Communities 计划推动，并由本地公司 ClicksandLinks Ltd 牵头私营部门合作开发。
evidence.quote_or_span: developed through the New Deal for Communities Initiative, in partnership with the private sector led by local company ClicksandLinks Ltd

evidence.statement: 试点向 Beswick、Openshaw、Clayton 的 450 人提供低价电脑或免费机顶盒，并配减免价格的互联网接入。
evidence.quote_or_span: giving 450 people ... either a low cost computer or a free set-top box ... together with Internet access at reduced rates

evidence.statement: 门户覆盖住房、就业、环境、警务四类优先服务，并可通过 PC 与电视访问，内容按设备自动重排。
evidence.quote_or_span: interactive public service in the four prioritised areas of housing, employment, environment and police ... accessible through both PCs and TV
evidence.context: 服务内容与多设备适配

evidence.statement: 副市长 Kath Robinson 表示，若项目在 East Manchester 成功，将向全市推广。
evidence.quote_or_span: If the project is successful in East Manchester, it will be rolled out across the city

evidence.statement: 第二阶段目标是通过 DfES 资金在 Beswick、Clayton、Openshaw 覆盖超过 4,500 户家庭。
evidence.quote_or_span: 'wiring up' in excess of 4,500 homes in the Beswick, Clayton and Openshaw communities ... through funding from DfES

evidence.statement: 计划产出包括 2,500 名居民家中拥有 PC、4,500 户新接入互联网、4,500 名居民接受 ICT 培训。
evidence.quote_or_span: Number of residents with a PC in the home 2,500; Number of homes with new internet access 4,500; Number of residents accessing ICT training 4,500

evidence.statement: 设备方案包括免费机顶盒、网络电脑、翻新 PC、新 PC 与少量移动设备，居民自付额从 0 到 200 英镑不等。
evidence.quote_or_span: Settop Box 0 1000; Network Computer 50 1000; PC (Recycled) 30 1000; PC (Recycled) 100 500; PC (New) 200 500 ... Phone 0 100

evidence.statement: 首批四个社区学习中心为 Beswick ICT Centre、The Grange、Surestart (Clayton)、Mill Street Centre，分别配置 15、15、15、10 台 PC。
evidence.quote_or_span: Beswick ICT Centre Sept 01 15; The Grange Sept 01 15; Surestart(Clayton) Sept 01 15; Mill Street Centre Now 10

evidence.statement: 每户至少一人需在领取设备前完成 3 小时培训；社区冠军提供一线支持，Eastserve 技术支持服务提供后备。
evidence.quote_or_span: One member of each household will receive initial 3 hour training course prior to collection and installation ... Community Champions to offer residents first level support

evidence.statement: Manchester City Council 通过 NDC 伙伴关系担任问责机构；指导小组包括居民、New East Manchester、EAZ、MCC、Manchester 2002、DfES、GONW。
evidence.quote_or_span: The accountable body will be Manchester City Council, via the New Deal for Communities partnership ... Residents; New Deal for Communities/New East Manchester Ltd; East Manchester Education Action Zone; Manchester City Council; Manchester 2002; DfES; GONW

evidence.statement: 实施里程碑为 2001-09 Clayton、2001-11 Openshaw、2002-01 Beswick 分阶段推广，2002-03 完成。
evidence.quote_or_span: September 2001 Commence 2-month roll-out programme for Clayton residents; November Commence ... Openshaw; January 2002 Commence ... Beswick; March Completion ... 'wiring-up' 4500 homes

evidence.statement: 到 2001 年 5 月初，试点已连接约 400 户（PC 或机顶盒）。
evidence.quote_or_span: by early May will have some 400 household connected up either by PCs or settop boxes

evidence.statement: Eastserve1 试点向居民提供了 300 台 PC，并开发了社区网站。
evidence.quote_or_span: an initial pilot project (known as East Serve) provided 300 PCs to residents and developed a community website

evidence.statement: NDC 于 2000-11 完成 WuC 投标；Eastserve1 目标是 10 个社区接入点和 450 户家庭联网。
evidence.quote_or_span: The NDC partnership developed the bid for WuC funding in November 2000 ... Eastserve1 aimed to provide 10 community based access points and 450 homes with Internet access

evidence.statement: WuC 项目与 NDC 办公室同址，当地称为 EastServe2。
evidence.quote_or_span: WuC is co-located within the East Manchester NDC office and became known locally as 'EastServe2'

evidence.statement: Eastserve 指导小组约每六周开会，同时承担 Network East Manchester 的运营职责。
evidence.quote_or_span: The steering group for the WuC meets approximately every six weeks. It operates as both the project board for EastServe and as the organisation which runs Network East Manchester

evidence.statement: 入户按 Clayton、Openshaw、Beswick 三阶段推进。
evidence.quote_or_span: The first phase delivered technology into Clayton, the second phase into Openshaw and the third into Beswick

evidence.statement: 初期营销困难：区域内项目过多，居民怀疑“低价给电脑”背后有政府监视，且宣传抬高了安装速度预期。
evidence.quote_or_span: There was also some suspicion ... that some form of snooping or investigation might take place ... some of the publicity ... raised people's expectations above what could be achieved particularly in relation to the speed of installation

evidence.statement: 设立 15 人居民小组；社区冠军每月开会并向指导小组提出建议。
evidence.quote_or_span: a Residents' Panel of 15 people was established ... 'community champions' ... met together once a month and were able to make recommendations to the Steering Group

evidence.statement: 设备组合后因社区兴趣不足而收缩为新手提/翻新 PC；新机约 200 英镑，部分居民通过本地信用合作社贷款。
evidence.quote_or_span: The option of the set-top boxes ... and of the network computers was subsequently withdrawn largely due to lack of community interest ... a new computer for £200 ... financed this with a loan from the local credit union

evidence.statement: 初始 ISP 倒闭后由 BT 替代；到 2002-09 约 2,200 名居民收到设备。
evidence.quote_or_span: The initial ISP went out of business and was replaced by BT. Almost 2200 residents had received the technology ... by September 2002

evidence.statement: 2002 年夏引入无线宽带；因区域缺乏 cable 覆盖；预计 2003-03 覆盖整个 WuC 区域。
evidence.quote_or_span: later on (summer 2002), a wireless broadband system was introduced. The alternative of using a cable connection was not available due to lack of coverage ... should cover the whole WuC area by March 2003

evidence.statement: 宽带定价为 15 英镑/月；低收入者 16 英镑/月（24/7）或 6 英镑/月（工作日 12:00-18:00）；到 2002-09 约 500 人接入宽带。
evidence.quote_or_span: The cost of broadband Internet ... is £15 per month ... for those on low incomes the cost is £16 per month for 24/7 access or £6 per month for limited access ... Almost 500 residents have taken up the option of broadband connection by September 2002

evidence.statement: 约 2,500 名居民参加了 3 小时课程；MANCAT 培训了 20 名本地社区冠军（预计增至 40 名）。
evidence.quote_or_span: About 2500 residents have attended the course ... MANCAT has trained twenty local residents as community champions ... expected to rise to forty

evidence.statement: 网站第二版于 2002-02 上线；引入住房报修与路灯故障报告。
evidence.quote_or_span: A second version of the site (February 2002) ... introduced a system by which housing faults can be reported ... faults in street lighting can be reported

evidence.statement: 六个月后随访调查：77.5% 使用者上网；78.4% 接受过培训；50.6% 用互联网找劳动力市场信息；19.3% 用于联系社区组织。
evidence.quote_or_span: 77.5% ... used it to access the Internet; 78.4% ... received some training; 50.6% ... search for labour market information; 19.3% ... local community groups

evidence.statement: 到 2002-09 约 2,200 户安装设备，低于原目标；摘要称超过 1,500 名居民接受培训。
evidence.quote_or_span: About 2200 households have had equipment installed to date (September 2002) although this is below the original target figures. Over 1500 residents have received training
evidence.context: 目标偏差（与正文 2,500 人存在口径冲突）

evidence.statement: 既有无线网络能力可支持约 10,000 名用户。
evidence.quote_or_span: the capability of the existing wireless network facilities to support around 10,000 users

evidence.statement: 项目资金可维持到 2004 年，并将任命主任推进后续发展。
evidence.quote_or_span: A Director is to be appointed ... funds are in place to sustain the project until 2004

evidence.statement: WuC 计划由 DfES 于 2000-09 至 2003-03 实施，资金 1,000 万英镑来自 Capital Modernisation Fund。
evidence.quote_or_span: the DfES ran from September 2000 until March 2003 ... funded with £10m from the Capital Modernisation Fund

evidence.statement: Eastserve 目标是提供接入与支持性学习的综合服务，促进社区咨询、参与、志愿部门能力、ICT 技能、就业、终身学习、本地内容与 UK Online 中心。
evidence.quote_or_span: Objective: provision of a comprehensive service of access and supported learning to develop community consultation and participation, capacity within the community and voluntary sector, ICT skill levels, employment ...

evidence.statement: Eastserve 目标为 NDC 区域 4,500 户。
evidence.quote_or_span: Targets: 4500 homes in the NDC area

evidence.statement: 实施方式为居民与志愿者参与的结构化伙伴关系、社区导师网络与社区在线中心。
evidence.quote_or_span: structured partnerships involving residents and volunteers, a community mentor network and community based online centres

evidence.statement: 技术方案为可选择的互联网接入设备（含翻新电脑），通过无线宽带与 ADSL 访问门户。
evidence.quote_or_span: An 'Internet access device' of choice (including re-cycled computers) with a web portal accessed through wireless broadband and ADSL

evidence.statement: 超过 3,500 户家庭获得不同层次的互联网接入，另有 17 所学校与 8 个在线中心。
evidence.quote_or_span: more than 3,500 homes ... equipped with varying levels of Internet access as well as 17 schools and eight online centres

evidence.statement: 多数居民选择 200 英镑新 PC 与 16 英镑/月常开 WiFi；另有 6 英镑/月机顶盒方案，含邮件与 Eastserve.com 内网。
evidence.quote_or_span: new PCs ... for £200 and connected up ... for just £16 a month ... for just £6 a month ... free set-top box and access to e-mail and the Eastserve.com Intranet

evidence.statement: 超过 90% 的参与者选择新电脑，部分通过本地信用合作社低息贷款。
evidence.quote_or_span: More than 90 per cent of takers have gone for the new computers thanks to a deal with a local credit union to provide low-cost loans

evidence.statement: 项目通过 WuC 获得约 130 万英镑，目标是连接 9,000 户中的 4,500 户。
evidence.quote_or_span: we bid for the Wired Up Communities cash and secured around £1.3m ... to aim to connect 4,500 of the 9,000 homes

evidence.statement: 区域仅约 75% 家庭有固定电话，项目经招标后采用无线网络。
evidence.quote_or_span: only about 75 per cent of people have landlines - we put the scheme out to tender and ended up with a wireless network

evidence.statement: 项目经理 Bob Jonas 在四座塔楼顶部安装天线，其中两座通过光纤接入互联网，再以无线电覆盖学校、在线中心和屋顶中继。
evidence.quote_or_span: Bob Jonas, mounted antennae on top of four apartment towers ... Two of the four receive the Internet through fibre-optic wire ... beamed to 17 schools and eight UK online centres ... rooftop antennae

evidence.statement: 报道时约 55% 的社区居民已联网。
evidence.quote_or_span: more than 55 per cent of the community is now linked to the web

evidence.statement: Eastserve 因纽约时报报道获得国际关注；报道称其为“走出东曼彻斯特衰败工业景观的虚拟护照”。
evidence.quote_or_span: described Eastserve as 'a virtual passport out of the decaying industrial landscape of East Manchester'

evidence.statement: Cisco Systems 提供的无线电发射设备使 6 平方英里的 East Manchester 可无线上网。
evidence.quote_or_span: Radio transmitters and wireless equipment provided by Cisco Systems has allowed six-square-miles of East Manchester to access the internet using Wi-Fi

evidence.statement: 报道同时提到建筑高度差异导致部分地点信号不足，以及项目成本与资金持续性的担忧。
evidence.quote_or_span: due to the different building sizes it has been difficult for some places to receive a signal strong enough ... Concerns were also raised ... about the cost of the project, and how long it will receive funding

evidence.statement: 无线网络覆盖 9,000 户；约 3,500 台 PC 由居民以补贴价购买；当时约 1,250 名网络用户。
evidence.quote_or_span: a local wireless network covering an area of 9,000 households. Approximately 3,500 PCs were purchased by residents at a subsidised rate and there are currently 1,250 users on the network

evidence.statement: eastserve.com 由市议会领导的法定与志愿组织伙伴关系开发，被视为更新进程的一部分，并用于 IntelCities 的公众参与与技术可用性测试。
evidence.quote_or_span: The community website ... has been developed by a local partnership of statutory and voluntary organisations led by the City Council and is seen as an important part of the regeneration process. It has been used as one of the vehicles for public engagement and testing the usability of the technology

evidence.statement: Eastserve 于 2000 年设立，资金来自 Beacons for a Brighter Future（管理 NDC 与 SRB 资金）和 DfES WuC 计划。
evidence.quote_or_span: The Eastserve project was set up in 2000, funded through the Beacons for a Brighter Future Initiative ... and the Department for Education and Skills Wired up Communities programme

evidence.statement: 项目提供 PC、基础 ICT 培训、社区帮助、在线服务、本地信息与低价无线宽带。
evidence.quote_or_span: provided PCs, basic ICT training, community help and support, access to online services and local information and low cost wireless broadband internet access

evidence.statement: 新电脑含外设售价 200 英镑，完整成本约 1,000 英镑；参加 3 小时本地培训是交易条件。
evidence.quote_or_span: a new computer with all the peripheral equipment cost just £200 against the full cost of £1,000, and attending a 3 hour training course in a local venue was part of the deal

evidence.statement: 项目向居民提供约 3,500 台 PC，并连接 1,500 户宽带。
evidence.quote_or_span: Eastserve has provided around 3500 PC's to residents in the area and has connected 1500 households with Broadband Internet

evidence.statement: 2002 年居民认知调查：31% 家中有电脑，其中 34% 通过 Eastserve 获得；87% 评价服务好/很好。
evidence.quote_or_span: Three in ten residents (31%) currently have a computer at home, and a third of these (34%) received it through Eastserve ... 87% rate the service it provides as good/very good

evidence.statement: 2003 年评估调查：47.2% 此前从未用电脑，63.8% 从未上网；50% 正在接受培训，其中 44% 获得 IT 资格；42% 至少每周登录；65% 看本地新闻；60% 用 Eastserve 邮件。
evidence.quote_or_span: Before Eastserve, 47.2% of respondents had never used a computer; 63.8% had never used the Internet; 50% were accessing training and of these 44% had got an IT qualification ... 42% log on ... weekly; 65% use it to access local news; 60% use Eastserve email

evidence.statement: 社区参与通过 15 人居民小组、社区冠军志愿支持、以及 intermediate labour market 安装就业实现。
evidence.quote_or_span: a Residents' Panel of 15 ... 'community champions' volunteered ... an 'intermediate labour market' scheme which gave some of them employment as part of the process of installing the IT equipment

evidence.statement: 第三期获 North West Development Agency 资助，目标是到 2007 年成为自我维持的企业。
evidence.quote_or_span: The third phase ... has now received funding from the North West Development Agency ... lead it to becoming a self-sustaining viable enterprise by 2007

evidence.statement: New East Manchester 与 Manchester City Council 签约 Symera Technologies 作为私营伙伴运营 Eastserve。
evidence.quote_or_span: New East Manchester and Manchester City Council sign up internet service provider, Symera Technologies, as a private-sector partner to run Eastserve

evidence.statement: 超过 5,500 名本地居民获得补贴电脑并参加电脑培训；Eastserve 有超过 1,500 名付费无线宽带用户。
evidence.quote_or_span: More than 5,500 local residents have received a subsidised computer and been on computer training courses. Eastserve has more than 1,500 paying customers

evidence.statement: 报道称 Eastserve 是英国最大的社区无线宽带网络，并计划扩展至 East Manchester 以外。
evidence.quote_or_span: Eastserve is the largest community wireless broadband network in the UK and will allow ... to expand its network beyond east Manchester

evidence.statement: McGonigle 称无线网络 2003 年启动时为欧洲最大社区宽带网络，并在商业供应商激烈竞争中存活。
evidence.quote_or_span: when the wireless broadband network was launched in 2003 it became the biggest community broadband network in Europe ... survived through a period of intense competition with commercial providers

evidence.statement: Symera Eastserve Limited 于 2009-02-10 注册，2017-02-28 解散。
evidence.quote_or_span: Incorporated on 10 February 2009; Dissolved on 28 February 2017

evidence.statement: Symera Eastserve 推出预付费 Wi-Fi，价格为 1 英镑/天、5 英镑/周；月费在付费墙处截断，仅见“£15 pe...”。
evidence.quote_or_span: Residents can pay £1 per day, £5 per week or £15 pe...

evidence.statement: 公司称已在多个 hotspot 提供服务，预计 2010 年底覆盖整个 East Manchester，并称将成为英国最大预付费社区 Wi-Fi 网络。
evidence.quote_or_span: expected to offer complete coverage across the East Manchester area by the end of the year, creating the largest 'pay as you go' community wi-fi networks in the UK

evidence.statement: VTH 为 Eastserve 提供基础设施；社区组织与第三部门合作回收并分发 350 台 PC 到 10 个免费互联网接入点。
evidence.quote_or_span: Local community organizations and third-sector businesses collaborated to recycle and distribute 350 PCs across ten free Internet access points

evidence.statement: WuC 随后分发 3,500 台电脑；新机 200 英镑、翻新机 50 英镑，含安装、配送、3 个月拨号与 3 小时培训。
evidence.quote_or_span: The Wired Up Communities initiative went on to distribute a further 3,500 computers ... available at a cost of either £200 or £50 ... installation, delivery, and 3 months' dial-up connection were included free, along with 3 h of introductory training

evidence.statement: 本地信用合作社提供低息贷款；共设立 9 个 ICT Learning Centres，并提供低价电脑维修服务。
evidence.quote_or_span: The local credit union provided immediate low-cost loans, and a total of nine local ICT Learning Centres were set up together with a low-cost computer repair service

evidence.statement: 因 25% 居民无固定电话，项目建设无线宽带，起价 6 英镑/月；覆盖翻倍，并再供应 1,700 个 PC 套餐。
evidence.quote_or_span: Since 25 % of local residents did not have a landline telephone, a wireless broadband network was developed to offer affordable broadband access from £6 per month ... network coverage more than doubled and a further 1,700 PC packages were supplied

evidence.statement: 到 2006-12，累计超过 5,500 个 PC 套餐、超过 2,000 名常规宽带用户；Eastserve 被称为欧洲最大无线网络（报道性）。
evidence.quote_or_span: With over 5,500 PC packages distributed and over 2,000 regular broadband customers by December 2006, Eastserve had developed into the largest wireless network in Europe

evidence.statement: 学术访谈将 Eastserve 列为“良好实践孤岛”，但质疑全市层面协调与推广。
evidence.quote_or_span: All of the academic respondents commented on the 'pockets of good practice' ... mentioning Eastserve ... The coordination of these small projects was questioned

evidence.statement: 2016-04 的 eastserve.com 页面标题为“Welcome To Cityserve”，提供 Cityserve 宽带、hotspot、PC 维修等服务。
evidence.quote_or_span: Welcome To Cityserve ... Cityserve Broadband the home of Wireless Internet Connectivity ... affordable PC repair service

evidence.statement: 页面列出 hotspot 价格：1.50 英镑/天（1GB）、5.50 英镑/周（5GB）、15.50 英镑/月（15GB）。
evidence.quote_or_span: £1.50 for 1 day's access / 1 Gigabyte Data Limit; £5.50 for 1 week's access / 5 Gigabyte Data Limit; £15.50 for 1 Month's access / 15 Gigabyte Data Limit

evidence.statement: East Manchester NDC 计划总额 7,700 万英镑（NDC 5,180 万 + SRB 2,590 万），于 2010 年 3 月底结束。
evidence.quote_or_span: £77m New Deal for Communities programme ... received £51.8m from New Deal for Communities and £25.9m from the Single Regeneration Budget ... closed at the end of March 2010

evidence.statement: 评估称 NDC 使犯罪下降 40%、失业下降 25%；1999 年 25% 居民感到紧密参与社区，2008 年为 53%。
evidence.quote_or_span: NDC helped cut crime by 40% and reduce unemployment by 25% ... In 1999 only 25% of residents felt closely involved in the local community, by 2008 the level was 53%

evidence.statement: 2008 年 10 月，MCIN 已接管 eastserve.com 的网站管理；报道称多年间网站经历多次变化，有好有坏。
evidence.quote_or_span: now that MCIN has taken over the management of the site ... there's been a number of changes, some of those will be for the better, some for the worse

evidence.statement: 项目始于 2001 年试点，连接 450 户家庭，后扩展为补贴电脑、培训、宽带与技术支持计划。
evidence.quote_or_span: What began as a pilot project in 2001 to hook up 450 homes to the internet has now expanded into an award-winning initiative

evidence.statement: 当时仅 19% 居民家中有电脑；约四分之一家庭没有 BT 固定电话。
evidence.quote_or_span: only 19% of people even had computers at home ... Around a quarter of homes did not have a BT landline

evidence.statement: 网络由两个主分发点和 60 多个接入点组成；报道称东曼彻斯特实际上是欧洲最大的 Wi-Fi hotspot。
evidence.quote_or_span: Through two main distribution points Eastserve links users ... more than 60 smaller aerials called access points ... east Manchester is effectively the biggest Wi-Fi hotspot in Europe
evidence.context: 技术架构与报道性评价

evidence.statement: 资费为 150kbps 6 英镑/月、1Mbps 20 英镑/月；直接借记用户速度免费翻倍。
evidence.quote_or_span: The 150kbps speed ... costs just £6 per month. The 1Mbps connection costs £20 per month ... Customers paying by direct debit have their speed doubled for free

evidence.statement: 翻新电脑 50 英镑、新机 200 英镑，含打印机与 3 个月免费接入；每次新客户含 3 小时免费培训；超过 3,500 名居民参加课程。
evidence.quote_or_span: Reconditioned computers come for just £50, or new systems for £200, both including a printer ... three months free Eastserve internet access ... three hours free training ... Over 3500 residents have attended these courses

evidence.statement: 项目经理 Athol Few 表示：无线网络启动时很创新，但“技术此后已经追上我们”；现在真正的创新是整套服务包。
evidence.quote_or_span: When we launched our wireless network it was certainly innovative at the time, although technology has caught up with us since. But what makes us really innovative now is that we provide a whole package
evidence.context: 技术相对优势下降（项目方自述）

evidence.statement: 门户链接市议会、e-government 与 NHS，并提供匿名低层级犯罪报告；过去 9 个月收到 650 多份报告。
evidence.quote_or_span: It links to the City Council and e-government sites, and the NHS ... online forms for anonymously reporting low-level crime ... In the past nine months over 650 reports have been filed

evidence.statement: 报道称服务面向东曼彻斯特“60,000 户家庭”。

researcher_decision.rationale: Accept 89 evidence items; keep conflicting values with reasons; treat 60,000 as reported; treat M13 monthly price as truncated; proceed to G3 accepting non-precise data.

conflict_notes.reason: 不同统计时点（2003 评估 vs 2006 杂志）与不同定义（收到培训 vs 参加课程 vs 累计参加）叠加；可能包含重复参加者，未做唯一人数去重。摘要的 1,500 可能采用更严格的完成/受训定义或较早截止时点。
9,000 为 WuC 目标区域户数；48,000 为 2014 年网络覆盖范围内户数（25km²/3,000 邮编）；60,000 为杂志所称更广 East Manchester 户数，可能指行政/人口范围而非接入户数；6 平方英里为物理覆盖面积，不是户数。
“regular”与“paying”定义不同，且可能涉及住房协会批量账户、试用/子账户是否计入；时点不同，也可能反映 2007–2009 年竞争与组织动荡下的真实流失，但现有数据不足以分离定义差异与真实变化。
3,500 为 WuC 分发电脑数；5,500 为 2006 年累计“PC 套餐”，可能包含更换、升级、多设备或重复计入，不等于 5,500 个唯一家庭。
M01 写 450 people（参与者），M02/M18 写 450 homes（家庭）；可能为同一批试点的不同计量单位或口径混用，保留原文单位。
2014 年报道未给公司号；CityServe (999) 已于 2013 年解散，二者可能为资产/业务承接而非同一法人；不得合并。
